failure_message: expected mat1 and mat2 to have the same dtype, but got: struct c10::BFloat16 != float
diagnosis: The V422 replay cast only the concatenated training sparse-feature matrix. Per-record held-out sparse features retained their captured bfloat16 dtype.
decision: Preserve this as a second execution-invalid attempt. Authorize one origin-boundary replay that converts the 384-wide sparse activation to fp32 immediately when it is created, covering both training and held-out consumers. No equation, tensor value beyond dtype representation, rank, data, source, seed, solver, route, gate, or component-write rule may change.
claim_boundary: Execution incident only; no architecture failure, quality, component, runtime, Phase 3, or superiority claim.
